name: How much does a typical door replacement project cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does a typical door replacement project cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a door replacement project varies widely based on the door material, style, size, hardware, and installation complexity. A basic steel entry door might cost less than a custom-designed fiberglass or wood door with sidelights. Installation labor also contributes to the total cost. It is best to get a detailed quote based on your specific needs and chosen door.
acceptedAnswer.description: Door replacement costs vary by material, style, size, hardware, and installation complexity. Custom doors cost more than basic options.
